'''Vujaar''' was a male [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where he asked an Imperial to make in incursion into the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]] and dispatch the Republic commandos stationed there.
